title: M3-PG principles
description: A Swiss-grid statement: a small two-line label in the first column, a huge uppercase semibold headline set solid over the other three, a quieter grey line under it, then three short cards side by side, each a semibold title over a grey hairline, a paragraph and an underlined 'read more' link. Stacks into one column on phones.
notes: no top padding: it expects the section above to end with whitespace (as the hero does)
